components: two lower dots and one lower-center dot beneath them
strokeOrder: draw the short upper head from left to right
continue down and around the deep bowl without lifting
lift, then place the lower-left dot
lift again and place the lower-right dot
lift again and place the lower-center dot

strokeOrderSource.citation: Persian Online, How to Write Persian Characters, چ demonstration at 00:35–00:41 (Liberal Arts Instructional Technology Services, Univ. of Texas at Austin)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The cited freehand lesson demonstrates isolated چ body-first: the short upper head travels left to right, then the same pen-down run turns through the hooked descent and deep bowl. The writer then lifts for three separate dots below in left, right, then lower-center order. Contextual joins reshape the head; this isolated Persian learner path fits the vendored Noto Naskh outline and retains Persian-scoped provenance rather than borrowing the independently verified Urdu source.
